opportunities.name: Research paper lookup and note logging (arXiv → Semantic Scholar → Notes)
opportunities.description: Search arXiv advanced search for a topic restricted to a specific year, open the top result, look up its title on Semantic Scholar for author/citation count, then save a summary note.
steps: Type topic in search term box
Tick the date checkbox, choose specific_year and enter YYYY
Click Search and open the first result
Copy title; go to Semantic Scholar and search the title
Open the paper, read first author and citation count
Open Notes, create new note: '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, <N> citations' and press Enter

instances.values: graph neural networks traffic forecasting (started, incomplete)

opportunities.name: Court case lookup with statute reference and note (CourtListener → Cornell LII → Notes)
opportunities.description: Search a case name on CourtListener, open the case for citation/decision date, search the related statute on Cornell LII, open its section, and save a note summarizing both.
steps: On CourtListener, type case name in keyword search and press Enter
Read the reporter citation and decision date
On Cornell LII, search the statute citation and press Enter
Open the statute section link to get its title
Open Notes and add '<case>: <cite>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<title>)' then Enter

instances.values: Miranda v. Arizona (case search only, no statute/note yet)
